form.name: Application for Permit to Drill an Oil or Gas Well (DOGAMI)
form.number: no form number printed on the copies read
form.notes: The current blank form is not linked on https://www.oregon.gov/dogami/mlrr/Pages/oilgas.aspx (page updated 12/18/2025: applications go by e-mail, fee and a paper copy by mail, an online permitting system is planned). I read two filed applications from the well log index (JH32-27-64-Giuseppe, a 1998-vintage layout, and IW32H-22-65, 2009), both one-page scans with a text layer, and a third (Hood, permit 583) that was an image with no text. Their layout (company, lease, well no., section/township/range and footages, field, county, elevation, mineral owner, surface owner, lessee, casing table, geologic objectives, proposed depth, DOGAMI approval box) may differ from the current form; cells marked form rest on it plus the page's list of required items (application, fee, bond, mineral rights, organization report, plan of operation, plat of pad with mud sump). Items missing from that layout are marked unknown, not none.

grade_reason: A free, reachable bulk spreadsheet with one row per permit (county, PLSS, lat/long, well type, depth, status, permittee) and an ApplicationDate, but no approval or issue date, no work type, and only 182 of 741 rows have a well type. Volume is tiny: about 7 rows dated 2025 and 20 in the last ten years, nearly all in the Mist gas field (Columbia County), mostly gas storage and observation wells.
producer_plan: Download OG_Permits_<date>.xls from https://www.oregon.gov/dogami/mlrr/Pages/oilgas.aspx (the file name carries a date, so read the link from the page each time). Keep rows with a valid ApplicationDate and count them by month: the unit is an application row, and a permit that was renewed or re-applied (the same PermitID with two dates) appears twice, so count distinct PermitID plus date. Split by WellType where filled (producer/exploration vs gas injection/withdrawal vs observation/monitoring); leave blank types as 'other'. New drill and re-entry cannot be told apart. The file has no approval date, so the monthly count measures applications filed, not permits approved; the signed approval date exists only in the scanned application PDFs. Expect 0 to 10 rows a year; a month is usually zero. The sheet is updated by hand a few times a year, so a monthly refresh gets mostly unchanged files. Parsing needs an .xls reader (xlrd or LibreOffice); the repository is standard library only, so convert to CSV by hand or ask DOGAMI for xlsx.
privacy_notes: The Permittee column names individuals ('Surname, Given' form) as well as companies, and some site and well names carry a person's name; the per-well application PDFs hold lessor and surface-owner names, addresses and phone numbers. Nothing was copied. Publish operators only when they are organizations.
